name: Shima Ryouko
source:
She was in the same class as the protagonist during medical school, and they went on to work together at the same “Date General Hospital.” Ever since then, she has viewed the protagonist as a rival.

She always maintains a dignified demeanor and is polite and upright. Although he acknowledges the protagonist’s skill as a doctor.

She resents the fact that there are always rumors of other women in his life, so she frequently picks fights with him.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130303161514/http://www.blackpackage.co.jp/products/r3/char.html]archived official site[/url]]
